headline: Gold Rises 1.9 Percent and Silver Gains 3.2 Percent Following Rebound
summary: Gold rose approximately 1.9% to USD 3,948 per ounce and silver advanced 3.2% to USD 50.63, recovering after heavy losses sustained in the previous session.
why: Precious metals are tracked by institutional investors as safe-haven assets and inflation hedges, experiencing frequent intraday volatility driven by macroeconomic sentiment.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Market prices for gold rebounded following prior session losses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Precious metals rebounded after heavy selling pressure in the prior session, triggering broad short-covering and technical buying.
